measure.description: Start the launch through the addon's measuring proxy.

proxy.description: Log every model request of the unchanged launch to `assets-ai/`; `measure` wins.

model.description: Passed as `--model`; replaces `opus`, `sonnet`, `fable` and `opus-proxy` with one custom candidate.

plugins.description: `false` skips the project's `marketplaces` plugins in every mode and runs this agent in your own `~/.claude` without installing anything.

home.description: Where the project's `marketplaces` plugins live. `host`, the default in `system` and `yolo` mode without an isolating runtime, installs missing ones into your own `~/.claude` and changes nothing you installed. `individual` runs in a separate agent home per marketplace declaration with the pinned plugin versions; `sandbox`, `custom` and isolating runtimes always use it.
